A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DepthForge research work. All 11 pages, including equations, figures, tables and references, support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original semantic-segmentation experiments, including benchmark mIoU results, component ablations and qualitative analyses in Section 5, Tables 1–6 and Figures 4–7.

after.justification: v2 retains these original DepthForge benchmark results, ablations and qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: The frozen visual/depth backbones, depth-aware tokens, attention optimization, depth refinement decoder and training objective are unchanged. Revised parameter counts do not document an architectural or procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use Cityscapes, ACDC, BDD100K, Mapillary and GTA5 with the same source-to-target transfers and adverse-weather scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding comparisons, including REIN, FADA, the earlier DGSS baselines, and the LoRA, AdaptFormer and VPT comparisons in Table 6.

E3.justification: Tables 5–6 revise the reported trainable-backbone sizes downward by 4.34M parameters for DepthForge. This is a limited revision to reported model-size settings; backbone identities, data splits, mIoU evaluation and training schedule remain unchanged, and no reconfiguration or rerun is documented.

E4.justification: The depth-cue configurations, component ablations in Table 4, convergence curves, t-SNE plots, attention/affinity maps and qualitative segmentation cases are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, uncertainty estimates or statistical significance tests. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Table 5 changes DepthForge's trainable parameters from 7.33M to 2.99M for CLIP, EVA02 and DINOv2, and from 8.85M to 4.51M for SAM. Table 6 repeats the EVA02/DINOv2 revisions. These counts now equal REIN's corresponding counts; all mIoU values and qualitative results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(8), feature/token definitions, frozen-backbone assumptions and mathematical descriptions are identical. No formal result, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about depth-guided geometric consistency, stronger generalization and effectiveness under extreme conditions.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and interpretations remain unchanged. The limitations paragraph still states approximately 4M additional parameters and possible interference between the two VFMs.

D1.justification: Tables 5–6 revise the documented trainable-backbone parameter totals without explaining the accounting change. Section 5.2's implementation, optimization, augmentation and GPU details, along with code-access information, remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning relative to previous methods and all 59 numbered reference entries are unchanged.

P1.justification: Siyu Chen gains a University of Glasgow affiliation; affiliation ordering and superscripts are adjusted, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All seven figures and six tables retain their graphics, structure, placement and captions. The parameter-cell updates do not alter table design, and there is no substantive layout revision.

improvement.justification: The substantive edits are unexplained parameter-count revisions; methods, accuracy results and analyses are unchanged. The lower counts may correct accounting, but Tables 5–6 specify backbone-only counts while the unchanged limitations still state roughly 4M additional parameters. The PDFs do not reconcile these quantities or establish which accounting is correct, so a net quality improvement or deterioration cannot be reliably determined.
